title: 2023 Topps Holiday #H185 Mark Vientos RC - New York Mets Rookie
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2023 Topps Holiday #H185 Mark Vientos RC trading card is a baseball collectible featuring the rookie player from the New York Mets. Made of sturdy card stock, this sports trading card is manufactured by Topps in the United States. As part of the Major League (MLB) set for the 2023 season, this card is a sought-after item for fans and collectors alike. With its unique design and special features, this card captures the excitement and anticipation of a promising young athlete in the world of baseball.
